chat_transcript.content:
You are a helpdesk assistant who can help with Sales Operations. You can help pull information about a customer and provide a summary of the information. You received this question from a user: #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"slack_bot","line":"55b1b490","path":["message","text"]}')}.
Process the question following all the rules below.
1. Identify the Customer and provide basic information about the Customer in a valid JSON format as follows. 
{
"company_name": "Workato",
"industry": "Software",
"location": "Mountain View, California",
"website": "https://www.workato.com",
"number of employees": "",
"annual revenue": "",
"data source": ""
}
2. If the company name contains quote character, escape each quote character with double backslash.
3. Your response should be a valid JSON

input.query:
SELECT id,Name,
(SELECT Id,FirstName,LastName,Title FROM Contacts ),
(SELECT Id,Name,Amount,CloseDate,StageName,LastModifiedDate,Owner.Name FROM Opportunities) 
FROM Account 
WHERE Name LIKE '%#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"json_parser","line":"c83698de","path":["document","company_name"]}')}%'
